summary: Backend testing complete for Tyre Express. 26/27 tests passed (96.3%). All auth, mechanics, requests, SOS, AI (Emergent LLM GPT-4o vision), and mock payment flows work correctly. MongoDB responses correctly exclude _id and password_hash. The single failure is Stripe card PaymentIntent creation because STRIPE_API_KEY in backend/.env is set to placeholder value 'sk_test_emergent' which Stripe rejects as an invalid API key. UPI and cash payment methods work; mock-confirm endpoint works. Auto-assignment of the nearest online mechanic works and returns full mechanic details, estimated_cost, and eta_min.

critical.issue: Stripe returns 'Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent'. The value STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent in /app/backend/.env is a placeholder, not a real Stripe test key. Requires a valid Stripe test secret key (format: sk_test_51... from https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/apikeys) to create real PaymentIntents. All other payment paths (upi, cash, mock-confirm) work.

minor.issue: Accepts online flag as query-string only (not JSON body). Works as designed but non-idiomatic REST; consider accepting request body.
No authorization check — any authenticated user (driver, unrelated mechanic) can update any request's status. Should verify user is either the requester or the assigned mechanic.
No check that requesting user is the request's owner or that status is 'completed'. Any authenticated user can post a review for any request and inflate mechanic ratings.
No ownership check — any authenticated user can fetch any request by id.
On LLM failure raises 500 with the raw exception message in detail (may leak internals). Consider returning a friendly error and logging details server-side only.

action_items: Replace STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent in /app/backend/.env with a real Stripe test secret key (sk_test_51...) so /api/payments/intent method=card works.
Add authorization checks on PATCH /api/requests/{id}, POST /api/requests/{id}/review, and GET /api/requests/{rid} to restrict to owner/assigned mechanic.
Optional: gate review submission on status=='completed' and prevent duplicate reviews per request.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file ~555 lines — approaching threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, requests, payments, ai) as it grows.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI in favor of lifespan context managers; not blocking but should migrate.
current_user dependency does not require role checks — endpoints that should be user-only or mechanic-only rely on ad-hoc if-statements; consider role-based dependencies.
mechanics_nearby uses in-memory haversine over all users (limit 500). For scale, use MongoDB 2dsphere geospatial index with $near query.
Password hashing uses bcrypt with default rounds — fine; JWT_SECRET is a hardcoded default in .env — must be rotated for prod.
seed_data_creation: Tests register ephemeral users prefixed 'TEST_' with random UUID suffixes. Seed mechanics (ravi/suresh/anil @tyreexpress.com) are auto-seeded by backend startup at Bangalore coords. No cleanup performed on TEST_ users (accumulating in db.users) — main agent may want a periodic prune, but does not affect functionality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with `pytest backend/tests/test_tyre_express.py -n 0` (serial). Tests share module-level STATE across classes so xdist loadscope (the default in pytest.ini) will break state sharing between classes — use -n 0 to override. All flows validated: register/login/me/location/online, mechanics/nearby (haversine sort), request auto-assign to nearest online mechanic (Ravi at 12.9716,77.5946), status transitions, review updates mechanic rating_avg, SOS contacts CRUD + alert map_link, AI /ai/analyze via Emergent LLM GPT-4o (returns valid schema), payments UPI/cash/mock-confirm. Only failing test: TestPayments::test_23_intent_card_stripe — fails due to placeholder Stripe key. If real Stripe test key is added, expect this to pass with client_secret starting 'pi_..._secret_...'.
rca_of_issue: RCA of Stripe card failure: backend/.env contains STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent' which is a placeholder string. Stripe's SDK rejects it with 'Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent' (401 from Stripe → we return 500). Reproduction: POST /api/payments/intent with {method:'card'} → 500. Mitigation: set STRIPE_API_KEY to a valid sk_test_51... from Stripe test dashboard, or use only the mock-confirm/UPI/cash paths (already working) for demo. Frontend can still simulate card payment via /api/payments/mock-confirm/{rid}.
